annotation.evidence_span: MUST NOT send a Last-Modified date that is later than the server's time of message origination (Date).
annotation.interpretation_a: The Last-Modified date must be equal to or before the Date header.
annotation.interpretation_b: The Last-Modified date can be slightly before the Date header, accounting for clock skew or processing time. The phrase 'later than' is not precise enough to exclude this possibility.
annotation.justification: The phrase 'later than' is open to interpretation regarding the acceptable margin of difference between the Last-Modified date and the Date header. Without a defined tolerance, implementations could reasonably differ on how strictly to enforce this requirement.
annotation.missing_information: The degree of permissible difference between Last-Modified and Date is not specified. Is a difference of milliseconds allowed? Seconds? The specification needs to define the acceptable tolerance.
